[i][b]How to install !![/b][/i]
1. Download alternative textures by peacefulend
2. download this mod
3. unzip and drop into your mods folder 

To use this in game buy the paint bucket from robins use it on the large futan bear to change it to whichever colour gloomy bear you want !
